correctness.rationale: The sign-specific proximal optimality condition with input rx and threshold c gives the asserted clipped affine maps, preserving [−a,a]; synchronous coupling contracts W₁ with factor r<1 and yields a unique invariant law. At a≤s, including equality, T_+(−a)=a and T_−(a)=−a force the two maps to be constant, so one step produces fair endpoint atoms. For s<a<b, monotonicity makes the worst initial point for a plus block −a, with image min(a,b−r^n(b+a)); this gives the stated least uniform constant-sign length, inclusive of the threshold equality. In fact no shorter mixed word can reset either: a first collapsing step must clip its entire nondegenerate interval to an endpoint, and monotone all-plus/all-minus bounds prevent reaching that endpoint from the appropriate extreme before N. A qualifying word occurs almost surely at a finite past time (use disjoint iid length-N blocks). Backward iteration is then a finite image of an endpoint, giving full mass to a countable set, not a claim about countability of its closure. The endpoints have mass at least 2^(−N); successive images of a under T_+∘T_− are s+r^(2j)(a−s), pairwise distinct atoms since their specified words have positive probability. At a≥b both clips are inactive on the invariant interval (with possible affine equality at a=b), giving the classical absolutely convergent signed series. If a maximal atom existed, both inverse affine branches would have to attain its mass; iterating the plus inverse exits [−b,b] from every x<b, while the minus inverse exits at x=b. This proves nonatomicity even with overlaps. The two image intervals cover [−b,b] exactly when r≥1/2; otherwise their separation gives the Cantor dimension by the open-set condition. Independence gives the variance and the fixed-objective stepsize threshold follows by rearranging a≤2τλ/(2−τμ). Independent replay `python3 /workspace/independent_reproduction.py 5` enumerated all sign words through length five for r=2/3,c=1 at a=s, a=3/2, and a=b, found the predicted respective first lengths 1,3,and none through five, and reproduced the middle orbit 3/2,1,7/9,55/81,… by exact proximal arithmetic. Neither word enumeration nor coupling asserts almost-sure convergence of forward paths.

value.rationale: A scalar quadratic with two shifted absolute penalties is a natural nonsmooth splitting with a fixed optimizer, not an arbitrary selected dynamical map. Its constant-step stationary law can change from endpoint-only to infinitely atomic to diffuse, behavior that expected objective rates do not describe. The sharp thresholds and least reset length characterize a distinct finite-word memory-loss mechanism and let practitioners distinguish genuine phase changes from finite simulation or rounding artifacts. This value is for the clipped proximal specialization, not for rediscovering the affine Cantor/interval dichotomy.
